_purpose: Reference template for what a real Slack ingestion event looks like end to end -- raw provider payload, then the canonical EventEnvelope it normalizes into (see modules/ingestion/envelope/schemas.py), then the decision record a golden-set example is built from. Golden dataset scenario packs (src/tests/fixtures/scenario_packs.json) currently use synthetic raw_transcript text and placeholder source_permalink values (e.g. https://example-slack.internal/...); this template exists so those synthetic examples can be authored/checked against what a real Slack payload and permalink actually look like, instead of an arbitrary guess.

raw_provider_payload._comment: Slack Events API 'message' event shape (conversations.history / event subscription), trimmed to the fields Locus actually uses.
raw_provider_payload.text: ok let's do that, going with 3 tiers -- Free / Pro / Enterprise, effective next pricing page update

normalized_event_envelope._comment: What normalizer.py should produce from the payload above, matching modules/ingestion/envelope/schemas.py::EventEnvelope exactly.
normalized_event_envelope.raw_content: ok let's do that, going with 3 tiers -- Free / Pro / Enterprise, effective next pricing page update

real_permalink_format._comment: Slack's actual chat.getPermalink format -- what source_permalink should look like once ingestion is real, replacing the golden set's https://example-slack.internal/... placeholders.

resulting_decision_record._comment: What this thread becomes downstream (matches sp-001 in scenario_packs.json) -- shown here so it's traceable back to a plausible real Slack thread, not just an assertion.
resulting_decision_record.decision_statement: Move from 5 pricing tiers to a simplified 3-tier structure: Free, Pro, Enterprise.
resulting_decision_record.rationale: 7 of the last 12 lost deals cited tier confusion; simplifying should speed the sales cycle.
